decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The flat roof area(s) of the development to which this permission relates shall not be used as a roof garden, balcony, seating area or other similar amenity area, and shall not be accessed except for the purpose of maintenance or in the case of emergency.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose ancillary or incidental, or both, to the residential use of the dwelling house currently known as 17 Pear Tree Close Chessington KT9 2BB as set out in the submitted application form signed 20.04.2026, unless otherwise first agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: The proposal has been assessed as householder development and were the habitable accommodation to be used as a separate unit of accommodation this would have implications for neighbouring amenity, standard of accommodation and levels of on-site car parking.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the Fire Safety Strategy hereby approved and thereafter maintained.Reason: In the interests of Fire Safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire safety) of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to commencement of the development (including any works of demolition), an updated arboricultural method statement and tree protection plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  This submission shall include:Full details of the proposed foundation design. The current AMS only recommends piled foundations, with the final design to be confirmed by a structural engineer.The location of all proposed piles clearly shown on the Tree Protection Plan.The routing and location of all new services, including any excavations, clearly indicated on the Tree Protection PlanThis additional information is required to ensure that the construction methodology and all below-ground works can be undertaken without causing unacceptable harm to the retained Oak tree and its Root Protection Area.The approved protection scheme shall be implemented prior to commencement of any work on site including demolition, and be maintained to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority until the completion of the development or until such stage as detailed within the approved AMS.Reason: To safeguard trees worthy of retention and in the interests of the character and appearance of the area, in accordance with policy G7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.This condition must be a pre-commencement condition in order to be effective.
description: Erection of a single storey rear outbuilding for ancillary use to main house.
